findings.current: Jin-ho once said, “Could the landlord of this building be Fabre, by any chance?”

findings.rationale: The source says 진호 형이, explicitly identifying Jin-ho as an older male friend; the accepted baseline also preserves “hyung.”

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful. Two minor details in the assembled copy shift relationship or count phrasing from the source.
